linkedin:
Does ChatGPT recommend your website? We checked ours.

We set up LLM Pulse for rankertoolai.com with 42 questions people ask about AI tools, across 5 AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode). 210 answers on day one.

Result: 0 mentions of our site.

What we learned:
→ Two large directories took almost every mention
→ The sources AI cited most were YouTube, Reddit and Zapier, not just blogs
→ Every number links back to the full AI answer, so you can see why

This is day 1 of a 30-day test (the trial was provided free by LLM Pulse). We'll share the day-30 numbers. Details and screenshots in the first comment.
